name: ppt-creation-expert
description: An AI presentation expert that creates general-purpose and customer-facing solution PPTs.

displayDescription.en: A presentation expert built on the Tencent Cloud Zhi (Lexiang) platform, tailored to Tencent Cloud templates. It integrates streamlined workflows for general presentations, customer-facing solution decks, executive briefing materials, and speech script generation.
displayDescription.zh: 基于腾讯云知（乐享）平台，整合通用汇报、面客方案、高拜材料与演讲讲稿生成的 PPT 制作专家

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 你好！我是 PPT 制作专家，可以帮你快速生成专业演示文稿。无论是通用主题汇报，还是面向客户的解决方案，把主题或资料发给我就行。你想做一份什么样的 PPT？
defaultInitPrompt.en: Hi! I'm your PPT Creation Expert. I can quickly turn your topic or materials into a polished presentation — whether it's a general report or a customer-facing solution deck. What kind of PPT would you like to create?

quickPrompts.en: Generate a customer-facing solution deck for the smart healthcare industry
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我生成一份智慧医疗行业的面客解决方案 PPT

quickPrompts.en: Create executive briefing materials for a client chairman meeting
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我做一份拜访客户董事长的高拜材料

quickPrompts.en: Turn this document into a presentation

description.zh: 连接后检索腾讯云知（乐享）知识库内容。
description.en: Search the Tencent Cloud Zhi (Lexiang) knowledge base after connecting.
